1. Device file descriptions using syz_open_dev
2. ioctl descriptions with proper in/out directions
3. Resource definitions (fd types)
4. Flag definitions
5. Struct definitions
6. The .const file format (how arch-specific constants are listed)

Read 2-3 example .txt files and their corresponding .const files to understand the format. Focus on device drivers (files starting with dev_). Also read any files that deal with similar character devices.
